summary: Someone meeting a member for the first time checks that they have found the right person.
realLife: Newly elected Oklahoma Senator Fred Harris recalled an elevator operator passing him by at the senators’ elevator. When the car returned, the operator asked who he was, and Harris gave his name and state.
inGame: The director’s relationship and earlier-talk reads distinguish a stranger from a previous contact.

turns.what: The visitor learns that the person at the desk is a staffer and asks for the member.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor has never seen either person before.
turns.writesBack: The staffer directs the visitor to the right office.

turns.what: At the return visit the attendant recognizes the member and asks only which floor they need.
turns.pulledBy: The two met at the same entrance earlier that week.
turns.writesBack: The second visit starts with directions and the introduction stays attached to the first encounter.
